<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

In the supplied two-practice educational construction, for all work, reserve and used units, selector and number of operations: a practice runs n cycles from ⟨w,q,z⟩ exactly when n = 0, or 2 ≤ w and the work covers the cycles the reserve does not support (q/2 supported cycles where the selector feeds the practice back, none otherwise); every operation of the learning goal consumes it, keeps the selector, adds the transition loss if any and appends one record. For every condition of the construction, the comparison warrants learning over attendance exactly under access loss with kept transition maintenance, and revision completes exactly there, that is exactly where it is warranted; for every such condition, after revision and reform n operations run exactly when n ≤ 5 (n ≤ 2 without reforming the selector), each consuming the new goal, and the earlier loss is retained. The comparison's definitions belong to the construction. The harmful headline is an instance: acquisition forms the attendance goal, the existing comparison supports learning, and five actual operations consume the new goal while retaining the earlier loss.
